raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the lifespan of Giuseppe Cesari as 36 years instead of 72 years, despite having already received accurate data (birth circa 1568, death in 1640 resulting in approximately 72 years). This error appears to have occurred due to a misinterpretation or oversight when analyzing earlier results provided by WebSurfer. The Planner did not validate the discrepancy and instead proceeded to use the incorrect lifespan in subsequent steps. This flawed assumption cascaded into the overall conclusion.
